[Lembar 1]
// Om // Om swastyastu, namo buddhaya, ya ta sanghyang dewata,
ya sanghyang swasa dewata, ya swasa wayu sanghyang titi, hring
dwa dwa, pradaksina dewadewi swasa, rajadanta
wadya rajadanta, swasa, rajahangsa lalita, //
paleography.indonesian_translation: Om. Om semoga dalam keadaan selamat dan sejahtera, sujud kepada Sang Buddha, itulah para dewata suci, Sang Hyang dewa pernapasan/nafas, nafas dan angin Sang Hyang penyeberang, hring dwa dwa, penghormatan pradaksina kepada dewa-dewi nafas, barisan gigi raja, pengiring gigi raja, nafas, keanggunan angsa raja.
paleography.english_translation: Om. Om may there be peace and well-being, salutations to the Buddha, those are the divine deities, the sacred deity of breath, breath and wind of the sacred crossing, hring dwa dwa, pradaksina reverence to the deities of breath, the royal teeth, royal tooth entourage, breath, graceful royal swan.

[Lembar 1]
nya, ya, pamahyunika, mangkana kramanya, hanane hangkap ring waneh,
nya, ya, manih kramanya, don intaran, uyah hyang, hulahin,
ya, waringin sungsang, yeh tamba hyang, mapupuk pulasahi,
ring walingah, || hana usadha, ka, [tidak terbaca] krama sasirang,
paleography.indonesian_translation:
Demikianlah penjelasannya, begitulah tata caranya, keberadaannya melengkapi yang lainnya.
Adapun tata caranya lagi: daun intaran, garam hyang, diproses/diolah.
Juga beringin sungsang, air tamba hyang, digunakan sebagai pupuk (obat tempel kepala) pulasahi,
pada dahi/pelipis. || Ada lagi pengobatan...
paleography.english_translation:
Such is the explanation, that is the procedure, complementing the others.
Further procedure: intaran leaves, sacred/purified salt, processed.
Also beringin sungsang, sacred healing water, applied as a poultice (pupuk) pulasahi,
on the forehead/temple. || There is another treatment...
